title: AI Clip Art Generator
summary: Free AI clip art generator: describe it and get flat, cute, line art or vintage clip art on a white or transparent background for slides and worksheets.
body_markdown:
### What is clip art?


Clip art is a simple, ready-made illustration, usually flat colour or line art on a plain or transparent background, that you drop into slides, worksheets, cards, signs and crafts instead of drawing a picture from scratch.


### Is there a free AI clip art generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made the clip art here, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### Can AI make clip art with a transparent background?


Yes. Turn on Transparent Background for GPT Image 2.6 in Flick and the image comes back as a PNG with no background, so the clip art sits directly on a slide, a coloured page or a photo.


### Can I get AI clip art as a vector file?


Yes. Turn on SVG (Vector) for GPT Image 2.6 in Flick to get a scalable SVG instead of pixels; it works from a prompt alone, while a generation with input images returns a PNG.


### How do I make a matching set of clip art?


Ask for every item in one image, arranged in a grid, with the same outline weight, the same palette and the same size, then use that sheet as a reference image when you add more pieces so they keep the same look.


### How do I make clip art for my classroom?


Describe the subject of the lesson, such as school supplies, weather, science or the seasons, in a bright flat style with thick outlines and no text, so the pieces read from across the room on slides, worksheets and wall displays.


### Can I turn clip art into a video?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe simple motion, such as a sun that bounces, a leaf that sways or hands cutting the printed sheet.
